svg.aria-label: Pleural effusion as an indented outline with numbered margin notes for the typed relationships
svg.text: Pleural effusion — annotated outline: taxonomy as a document, relationships as margin notes
Indentation is subsumption; numbered margin notes are the typed relationships. ◂ n markers on a row are the relationships that point at it.
THE TAXONOMY — ONE SUBTYPE TREE OVER FINDINGS, DIAGNOSES, AND THE GROUPING NODE
binds: presence (required) · change from prior · size (qualitative): amount · fluid attenuation · internal complexity (multi-select)
internal complexity values: septations · loculation · gas · dependent debris · fluid-fluid level
ATTACHED BY RELATIONSHIP ONLY — NO SUBSUMPTION EDGE
CLINICAL CAUSES — DIAGNOSIS NODES WITH NO IMAGING ELEMENTS
expect: right pleural space in most cases
expect: simple · bilateral, right greater than left
expect: small to moderate · ipsilateral to the pneumonia
the parapneumonic effusion subtype names this cause
